title: Serpong Warrior Challenge Run 2026 Review: What the 2025 Edition Was Like
seo_title: Serpong Warrior Challenge Run Review | Tangerang Selatan
meta_description: Serpong Warrior Challenge Run review: road running plus an obstacle course at Summarecon Mall Serpong. What 2025 runners said, and the 2026 format.
dek: A road race and an obstacle run in one event, at Summarecon Mall Serpong. Here is what runners said about the October 2025 edition, and how the format changed for 27 September 2026.
verdict: The Serpong Warrior Challenge Run is not a straight road race. Alongside a 5 km, 10 km and half marathon, its signature category is an obstacle run ending in a maze with artificial rain and a man-made waterfall [1]. Runners who did the 2025 edition, on 5 October, described it as different from other races and hard to forget [1]. For 2026 it moved to 27 September at the same venue, with a 5 km, the half marathon and obstacle runs over 7 km and 12 km [2]. If you want a road half marathon, it offers one. The reason to choose this event over others nearby is the obstacle course.

sections.heading: What the 2025 Edition Was Like
paragraphs: The 2025 race was run on Sunday 5 October at Uptown Park, Summarecon Mall Serpong, with five categories: a 5 km run, an 8 km obstacle run, a 10 km, the half marathon and a kids' obstacle run [1]. Kumparan, whose running club took part, called it the biggest running event in the Serpong area [1].

The obstacle run is what runners talked about. One member of the club said the 8 km obstacle was really different from other running events because it was not only on the road, and that the obstacles kept it from being boring [1]. Another described the final challenge: a winding maze with artificial rain overhead and climbing plants along its length, ending with runners coming out from behind a man-made waterfall into a lake [1]. A third said that despite the obstacles they finished with their best time [1].

sections.heading: The 2026 Format
paragraphs: For 2026 the event moved to Sunday 27 September, again at Summarecon Mall Serpong, with the finish at Uptown Park [2]. The categories changed: a 5 km, the 21 km half marathon, and obstacle runs over 7 km and 12 km [2]. There was no longer a flat 10 km, and the obstacle course now came in two lengths.
Bank BRI sponsored the 2026 race, with app-based promotions and games at the venue [2]. The coverage available so far is sponsor material, not a report on how the 2026 race went.

sections.heading: Should You Enter Next Year?
paragraphs: Choose it for the obstacle course. The 2025 runners' accounts are of a fun, novel event, and the waterfall-and-maze finish is not something a normal road race offers.

Keep the source in mind. Those accounts come from members of a media company's own running club, published by that company, and they are enthusiastic in the way such pieces usually are. They tell you what the course contained. They are less reliable on how well it was organised.
This review is compiled from published reporting on the 2025 edition and sponsor material on the 2026 race. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: What is the Serpong Warrior Challenge Run?
faqs.answer: A running event at Summarecon Mall Serpong in Tangerang Selatan that combines road races with an obstacle run. In 2025 the obstacle course finished with a maze under artificial rain and an exit through a man-made waterfall.

faqs.question: What distances were offered in 2026?
faqs.answer: A 5 km, the 21 km half marathon, and obstacle runs over 7 km and 12 km, on Sunday 27 September 2026. The 2025 edition had a 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, an 8 km obstacle run and a kids' obstacle run.

faqs.question: When was the 2025 Serpong Warrior Challenge Run?
faqs.answer: Sunday 5 October 2025, at Uptown Park, Summarecon Mall Serpong, in Tangerang Selatan. It offered a 5 km, an 8 km obstacle run, a 10 km, the half marathon and a kids' obstacle run. For 2026 the event moved earlier, to Sunday 27 September, at the same venue.

editorial_notes: Rewritten 2026-09-28 about the previous edition (5 October 2025). Replaces a pre-race preview.
